The {{PAGENAME}} is a single-use item which is required to fix the [[Mill]]. It can be obtained by talking to the [[Astrologer]] when
continuing [[Ms. Charm]]'s quest line. You need 60 Reputation with [[Astrologer]] to get the calculations.

The calculations have to be used at the door of the mill, not at the door of the mill-house.
